## Rules

| Category | Rule | Result |
|---|---|---|
| root `not-living` or `temporary` (`detritus<not-living`, `t001`) | never an occurrence | `excluded` |
| phylogenetic (type P) with an `aphia_id` on the node | use it, verify in WoRMS, publish under the valid name | `aphia` |
| phylogenetic without an `aphia_id` | exact name match in WoRMS; no hit stops the build | `name_match` / `unresolved` |
| morphological under Biota (`egg<other`, `nauplii<Cyclopoida`) | nearest ancestor with an `aphia_id`, unless it is only Biota | `ancestor` / `excluded` |

The decision is pure and tested without the network (`tests/testthat/test-taxa.R`); WoRMS is injected, so the
same code runs against a canned WoRMS in the tests and against `worrms` here.

```{r}
#| label: setup
librarian::shelf(worrms, dplyr, readr, tibble, here, quiet = TRUE)
for (f in list.files(here("R"), pattern = "\\.R$", full.names = TRUE)) source(f)
PROJECT_ID <- 2L
LOOKUP_CSV <- here("metadata/taxa_lookup.csv")
```

## The node's own taxonomy for the categories in use

```{r}
#| label: taxa
used <- ecotaxa_project_taxo_stats(PROJECT_ID)$used_taxa
taxa <- ecotaxa_taxa(used)
# the ancestors too, so a morphological category can be re-parented onto a living one
anc  <- setdiff(as.integer(unlist(strsplit(taxa$id_lineage, ","))), taxa$ecotaxa_id)
taxa <- bind_rows(taxa, ecotaxa_taxa(anc)) |> distinct(ecotaxa_id, .keep_all = TRUE)
taxa |> filter(ecotaxa_id %in% used) |> select(ecotaxa_id, display_name, type, rank, aphia_id, lineage)
```

## Decide, then fill from WoRMS

```{r}
#| label: lookup
decided <- taxa_decide(taxa) |> filter(ecotaxa_id %in% used)
lookup  <- taxa_worms_fill(decided)
write_taxa_lookup(lookup, LOOKUP_CSV)
lookup |> select(ecotaxa_id, ecotaxa_name, decision, aphia_id, scientific_name, rank, status, note)
```

```{r}
#| label: summary
lookup |> count(decision)
```

`metadata/taxa_lookup.csv` is committed: it is the artifact a taxonomist reviews and the one notebook 03 reads.
An `unresolved` row stops notebook 03 until someone edits the CSV (set `decision` and `aphia_id` by hand) or
fixes the category on the node.
